name: Bloodletting
source:
On a perfectly normal day, 27 year old loner Stanley's throat was slit in broad daylight in a random attack.

The culprit was never caught.

Cheating death comes with its own perks, among them is giving renewed perspective. Turns out this is what he needed to turn his life around, by a macabre silver lining he's been gifted a unique opportunity.

Ride the tiger.

[From [url=https://born2coast.itch.io/bloodletting]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个再寻常不过的日子里，27岁的独行青年斯坦利在光天化日之下遭遇无差别袭击，被人割断了喉咙。

真凶始终未能落网。

从死神手中捡回一条命自有其意外的好处，其中之一便是让人对人生有了全新的体悟。事实证明，这恰恰是他扭转人生所需的契机——在这道骇人却诡异的转机背后，命运赋予了他一次独一无二的机遇。

骑虎难下，那就迎难而上吧。

[摘自[url=https://born2coast.itch.io/bloodletting]itch.io[/url]]
